varlistentry.listitem: : is a pointer representing dtn to be deleted.

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: Given a pointer ptr of dtn, dtn_delete(ptr,"ptr") frees the memory hold by the pointer ptr and clears ptr in Scialb interpreter. If no parameters are given to dtn_delete(), then all pointers of differents dtn will be deleted.
